name: A mine south of Darkshire

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic quest-chain scene; in-world date unknown

summary: Jonathan Carevin has no record of the elven priestess, but he knows the worgen and the place where they were first found in Duskwood. His family cannot follow every rumor; he asks the seeker to inspect Roland’s Doom and report any sign of the Scythe. The request points toward evidence rather than certainty. The quest does not say that the artifact caused every darkness in the forest, only that the mine may connect the missing weapon with the creatures who appeared there.
